name: codex-project-index-recovery
description: Diagnose missing local Codex Desktop projects and prepare reviewed index recovery candidates. Python 3.11+ and local filesystem access required.

interface.longDescription: Diagnose missing local Codex Desktop projects using stable private snapshots. Validate SQLite integrity and prepare a candidate for a supported empty sidebar cache. Local filesystem access and Python 3.11+ required. The bundle does not apply live repairs or close apps: the agent prepares a reviewed, version-specific executor when supported and authorized. It does not recover deleted source files or prevent outages.
